args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the latest Brightline Freight newsletter, its linked article, and the subscriber companion piece:

• Newsletter: This week's edition covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, pointing to a feature article on the Brightline blog plus a subscriber-only companion piece.
• Article (blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece (insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion, subscriber access): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
